user_reported_failure_samples.note: Sample counts come from pasted worker responses and are not asserted to cover all failed chats.

root_causes: Raw SQL tool invocation can be blocked before reaching Supabase by platform safety controls.
The v2 worker ABI returned packet.instruction inside Supabase tool output, which the connector labels untrusted and workers may not follow as instructions.
preserved_evidence: No old tasks, members, outputs or events were deleted.
All C/E0 runs were moved to STALLED after contamination classification.
design_vaccine: Worker hot path must never require executing instructions returned by a tool. Tool output may carry typed data only; executable semantics must come from trusted user/system context.
